name: Salt River (Upper Salt / Salt River Canyon Wilderness)
blurb: Multi-day Class III-IV wilderness whitewater from the US-60 bridge to the AZ-288 bridge. Tonto NF boater permit (lottery) Mar 1-May 15; White Mountain Apache Tribe permit for the first ~29 miles.

sections.notes: Tonto NF: 'The Upper Salt River is a solid Class III-IV river and requires whitewater boating skills.' 'at low water a few of the rapids approach Class V.' Take-out is just downstream of the Highway 288 Bridge on river left, 52.3 miles from First Campground. Permit Mar 1-May 15 (lottery; $125 boater permit fee; application dates differ between the Tonto page and Recreation.gov). White Mountain Apache Tribe permit required for the ~29 miles below the US-60 bridge; boating prohibited above Apache Falls.
sections.mapPendingReason: First Campground (Upper Salt put-in): No managing-agency coordinate: the launch is on White Mountain Apache land (tribal permit required); the Tonto NF area map PDF is image-only and gives no coordinates. Highway 288 Bridge Take-out (Upper Salt): Tonto NF names the take-out (just downstream of the Highway 288 Bridge, river left) but publishes no coordinate for it.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
